question.text: A call option with strike Rs 180 and premium Rs 10 breaks even when the market price at expiry is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Call breakeven = Strike + Premium = 180 + 10 = Rs 190. At Rs 190, the intrinsic value (190-180=10) exactly offsets the premium paid (10). The Trap: Rs 180 is ATM (zero intrinsic, full premium loss). Rs 170 is OTM. Rs 200 generates profit of Rs 10.
